name: suede-code
description: Suede Labs AI combined code review and ship grade in one pass: findings with file:line evidence plus an A-F lane grade, Instant-F security triggers, OWASP checks, a deploy-safety gate, and fix briefs. Use when asked to review this, grade this, security-check this, is this safe to ship, or check this PR before merge — whenever the caller wants both what is wrong and whether it ships. Runs only when explicitly invoked; never auto-fires on a diff, save, or commit. NOT FOR: findings only with access
author: JasonColapietro
summary_zh: 一款按需运行的代码审查工具，可定位问题、检查安全风险并评估 PR 是否适合合并或发布。
